{% sql { "query" : "select name as Name, Description, STRFTIME('%d/%m/%Y', SUBSTR(date, 1, 10)) date_maj, Status as Status, Web from Resources where Type='CodeSystem' and (id GLOB 'tre-r[0-9]*' or id GLOB 'TRE-R[0-9]*' or id GLOB 'TRE-G[0-9]*' or id GLOB 'TRE-A[0-9]*') and json_extract(Resources.json,'$.supplements') is NULL and json_extract(Resources.json,'$.status') != 'retired' order by substr(name,5,1), abs(substr(name,6, instr(substr(name,6,4),'_' )-1)) ", "class" : "codes", "columns" : [ { "name" : "Name", "type" : "link", "source" : "Name", "target" : "Web"}, { "name" : "Description", "type" : "markdown", "source" : "Description"}, { "name" : "Date MAJ", "type" : "markdown", "source" : "date_maj"}, { "name" : "Status", "type" : "markdown", "source" : "Status"} ] } %}
